text_block_list.text:
On the way back from
going shopping with Transcend...

Ah—!
Tran-san~♪ And Trainer-san~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Umm, excuse me! Would you like to go on a date with Curren? ♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see.
They're doing that "Date Fair" right now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's that deal where if you come in a group,
you get all-you-can-eat desserts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♡ That's right~
Ayabe-san wouldn't hang out with me today.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan, have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I grabbed lunch before heading out.
More importantly, I wanna get back and try out my new gadgets—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh! ...Are you really sure?
We're gonna have a ton of fun, you know?
Just Curren and Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Chocolate sweets♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ch-Chocolate!?
Wait, but according to my intel, it was supposed to be a different all-you-can-eat—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The menu just got changed~♪ On the store manager's whim.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate parfaits... chocolate donuts...
chocolate pies, a chocolate waterfall, chocolate pudding!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trainer-cha~n, wanna go on a date?♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was actually totally stuck~
with my gadget crafting. Which brings us here.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: My brain... desires... chocolate!
choice_data_list: You'll have to make do with convenience store sweets.
Let's eat up all the chocolate!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh.
Turning down a date with such cute girls, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Moo moo. Boo boo.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Guh! Pure, indisputable logic! The end!!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Aah, I ate so much... It's soaking right into my brain...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is super happy we got such wonderful photos too!
I'm gonna post them to Umastagram right away♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#Seniors #With #Date♡
#WonderfulInfo #AlwaysThankYou♪
#DidIRepayYou?'
